question: Which among the following Buddhist Universities is located in Bihar, India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nalanda University**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Nalanda University**, which is located in Bihar, India, and was one of the oldest and most renowned Buddhist universities in the world.
 
• Nalanda University was founded in the **5th century CE** and attracted scholars and students from all over Asia, contributing to the development of Buddhism, philosophy, astronomy, and other fields.
 
• Vallabhi University is a historical university in Gujarat, India, known for its contribution to the study of Sanskrit literature and Jain philosophy.
 
• Somapuri University, also known as Paharpur University, is located in Bangladesh and is known for its archaeological discoveries related to the ancient Buddhist monastery in Paharpur.
 
• Nabadwip University is a newly established university in West Bengal, India, focused on the study of ancient Indian knowledge systems.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Vallabhi University, on the other hand, was established in the 6th century CE and was known for its contribution to Jain philosophy and Sanskrit literature.
 
• Somapuri University, also known as Paharpur University, is located in Bangladesh and is known for its archaeological discoveries related to the ancient Buddhist monastery in Paharpur.
 
• Nabadwip University is a newly established university in West Bengal, India, focused on the study of ancient Indian knowledge systems. However, it is not a Buddhist university.
